lines.beaver: 가족 모임 날짜 정했어? 나도 같이 갈 거니까.
lines.beaver_en: Did you set the family gathering date? I'm coming too.
lines.beaver_roman: gajok moim naljja jeonghaesseo? nado gachi gal geonikka.
lines.en: Not yet. It's really hard to pick a date.

lines.beaver_en: Why? Are there a lot of people?
lines.en: Yeah, there are five siblings and lots of relatives.
Yes, both my aunts on dad's and mom's side are coming.
There are three young kids. They're bringing all the kids too.

lines.beaver_en: Then a holiday would be good.
lines.en: Right. How about the first day of the long weekend?

lines.beaver_en: Sounds good. Are the elders okay with it?
lines.en: My mom says it's fine. My dad was against it.
He works that day, so he says it's hard to take off.

lines.beaver_en: Then how about the second day?
lines.en: Good. I'll talk to my dad again.

lines.beaver_en: Are you doing anything special this time?
lines.learner: 다 같이 한복 입고 가족사진 찍어.
lines.en: We'll all wear hanbok and take a family photo.
lines.roman: da gachi hanbok ipgo gajoksajin jjigeo.

lines.beaver: 와, 멋지다! 나도 꼭 같이 갈게.
lines.beaver_en: Wow, that's great! I'll definitely come along.
lines.beaver_roman: wa, meotjida! nado kkok gachi galge.
lines.en: Thanks. Let's meet on the morning of the second day!
